title: 第17章 焚天塔仿品第18章 再次对战柳沐
lines: 萧青山的话音刚落，大厅里突然响起一阵清脆的玉器碰撞声。
二长老手中的茶盏摔在地上，深褐色的茶汤在地砖上蜿蜒成扭曲的蛇形。
家主是说...
三长老萧远山的声音发颤，布满老年斑的手掌死死抓住扶手，
只要得到那件仿品，就能感应到真正的焚天塔？
主座上的萧青山缓缓点头，玄色长袍上的金线暗纹在烛火中忽明忽暗。
他抬手在虚空一划，一道水镜凭空浮现。
画面中正是林烬在擂台上祭出黑色小塔的瞬间，
塔身上隐约可见的火焰纹路突然泛起红光。
诸位请看。
萧青山指尖点在镜面，红光骤然化作十二道火蛇，
在塔尖盘绕成古老符文，
这是焚天塔特有的离火真纹，当年先祖手札中记载，
唯有沾染过焚天塔本源之力的器物才会显现。
而那林家小子林烬身上携带的那件焚天塔仿品正是其中关键！
因为那是用真正的焚天塔上的一角炼制而成，
因此，绝对能够凭借其感应到焚天塔的存在！
大长老萧空突然起身，腰间悬挂的青铜罗盘发出刺耳鸣响。
他布满沟壑的脸上泛起异样潮红：
天机盘在震动！
难道说...那孩子身上的仿品，真的是寻找焚天塔的契机？
这话如同一块巨石投入深潭，整个议事厅沸腾起来。
五长老猛地拍案：
十年前林家大长老在林烬出生时莫名陨落，
时候传出林家大长老入魔欲夺取林烬的九狱炎骨血脉，
就是希望一次寻找焚天塔！
莫非就是那时——
话未说完便被萧青山凌厉的眼神打断。
此事涉及我萧家千年谋划。
萧青山袖袍一挥，水镜化作雾气消散，
三日后便是林烬再次离开炎城之时，届时...
他的目光扫过众人，最后落在脸色苍白的萧逸身上，
对了逸儿，你与那林浩交过手，可还记得他功法路数？
萧逸刚要开口，突然剧烈咳嗽起来，指缝间渗出点点猩红。
他望着掌心血迹，眼中迸发出怨毒之色：
那杂种...咳咳...看似使用林家基础功法，
但每灵力运转时，胸口都会闪过暗黑色纹路...
魔族功法！
萧空失声叫道，
原来如此！
content_en:
As soon as Xiao Qingshan finished speaking, a crisp sound of jade clashing suddenly sounded in the hall.
The tea cup in the second elder's hand fell to the ground, and the dark brown tea soup twisted into a twisted snake shape on the floor tiles.
The owner is saying...
Third Elder Xiao Yuanshan's voice was trembling, and his hands covered with age spots tightly grasped the armrest.
As long as you get that imitation, you can sense the real Burning Sky Tower?
Xiao Qingshan, who was sitting on the main seat, nodded slowly, and the golden thread pattern on the black robe flickered in the candlelight.
He raised his hand and drew it in the void, and a water mirror appeared out of thin air.
In the picture, it is the moment when Lin Jin sacrifices the small black tower on the ring.
The faintly visible flame patterns on the tower suddenly glowed red.
Please take a look.
Xiao Qingshan pointed his fingertips on the mirror, and the red light suddenly turned into twelve fire snakes,
Coiled into ancient runes at the top of the tower,
This is the unique Lihuo True Pattern of the Burning Sky Tower. It was recorded in the ancestor’s handwriting at that time,
Only artifacts that have been contaminated by the original power of the Burning Sky Tower will appear.
And the replica of the Burning Sky Tower carried by Lin Jin, the boy from the Lin family, is the key to this!
Because it was made from a corner of the real Burning Sky Tower,
Therefore, you can definitely sense the existence of Burning Sky Tower with it!
The great elder Xiao Kong suddenly stood up, and the bronze compass hanging on his waist made a shrill sound.
His furrowed face was strangely flushed:
The heavenly disk is vibrating!
Could it be that...the imitation on that child was really an opportunity to find the Burning Sky Tower?
These words were like a huge stone being thrown into a deep pool, and the whole chamber was boiling.
The Fifth Elder snapped the case:
Ten years ago, the eldest elder of the Lin family died inexplicably when Lin Jin was born.
At that time, it was reported that the elder of the Lin family was possessed by a demon and wanted to seize Lin Jin's Nine Hell Flame Bone bloodline.
I just hope to find the Burning Sky Tower at once!
Could it be that that time——
Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Xiao Qingshan's sharp eyes.
This matter involves my Xiao family’s thousand-year plan.
Xiao Qingshan waved his sleeves and robe, and the water mirror turned into mist and dissipated.
Three days later it will be time for Lin Jin to leave Yancheng again. By then...
His eyes swept across everyone, and finally fell on the pale Xiao Yi.
By the way, Yi'er, you have fought against Lin Hao, but do you still remember his techniques?
Just as Xiao Yi was about to speak, he suddenly coughed violently, and a little scarlet oozed from between his fingers.
He looked at the blood on his palms, and a look of resentment burst out from his eyes:
That bastard...ahem...seems to be using the basic skills of the Lin family.
But every time the spiritual power is running, dark black lines will flash on the chest...
Demon Cultivation Technique!
Xiao Kong cried out loudly,
That’s it!
title_en: Chapter 17 Imitation of Burning Sky Tower Chapter 18 Battle against Liu Mu again
